content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the GNDU Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of GNDU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the GNDU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by Guru Nanak Dev University, Amritsar (GNDU) to fill multiple vacant posts under Advertisement Number 13/2026 for eligible and qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available in GNDU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for Officer on Special Duty and Assistant Professor positions across different specialized subjects like English and Punjabi in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application registration process officially starts on 01 October 2026. Candidates can submit their online applications through the official website digital.gndu.ac.in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for GNDU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration and submission of the application form, along with the hard copy submission, is 21 October 2026. Applicants must complete submissions beforehand.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in the relevant subject along with NET, SLET, SET or a Ph.D. degree as per UGC guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Officer on Special Duty post?
faq.answer: The Officer on Special Duty (OSD) appointed through this recruitment process will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month throughout their service term.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: General category applicants are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1180/- online while submitting their recruitment forms through the GNDU digital portal.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee concession for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, SC, ST, and PWD candidates belonging to Punjab domicile are required to pay a reduced application fee of Rs. 590/- for this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for GNDU Various Posts?
faq.answer: The selection procedure involves short-listing of qualified candidates based on academic records and credentials, followed by a personal interview conducted by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send the hard copy of the online application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send one printed copy of their online application along with self-attested document copies to The Registrar, Guru Nanak Dev University, Amritsar-143005, Punjab.
